info.name: Prospeva Websites (Business panels, Employer panel, Admin panel)
info.description: PROSPEVA WEBSITES (3 panels). 01 Business panels (8 workspace types: sign in as the type you want, token saves to {{vendorToken}}). Employer panel (token {{corporateToken}}). Admin panel (token {{adminToken}}). Agent portal, Lender portal, Employee and supporting APIs are listed at the end. Full guide: Prospeva_Websites_API_Guide.
